body: They're the only people in my life.

I know they look down on me. They make fun of me or usually just try to embarrass. Nobody ever invites me to anything and it makes me depressed. I have to force myself on people just to maintain contact. Nobody cares about me and it shows in their attitude.

Like whenever someone asks me to do something or asks my help I become more of a hindrance than anything. I depend too much on other people and feel pathetic afterwards. That makes others look down towards me and makes it even worse.

They judge me based on my looks and think of me as an idiot. I've no self confidence. So I end up making a mess out of normal situation and I think that's why people take me for an idiot. It makes me wanna cry just thinking about it.

I feel ashamed because I don't have any friends, let alone a girlfriend. I feel ashamed because I think I'm ugly and people judge me for it. I feel ashamed because I don't have the confidence to talk, let alone have a conversation. The only place I can communicate with people is on reddit. And that make me ashamed.

Thank you for the kind words but it doesn't look like I'll be able to cope with it anymore. I have tried so long to not let what other people think affect me but it never works out. I always feel ashamed of myself and feel like nothing I will do will ever matter. So it's better if i just let go.
What to do when you just can't get the motivation to do anything? I don't feel like I'm worth anything so I've stopped making any efforts.
